task.title: Enabling and Using Favorite Filters in Queries
task.shortdesc: Favorite Filters allow runtime users to created preferred views by saving and reusing filters created

context.p: Favorite Filters allow runtime users to created preferred views by saving and reusing filters created for executed Search & Select and Query actions. These Favorite Filters are unique to each user and saved locally. Each app can have more than one Favorite Filter, and they can be used by the same user across more than one app.
The examples shown in the following sections are for a Search & Select action–the same filters can be created with a Query action requiring user input.
